(2) watchPaths + classic.FileChanged works for a file or folder, globs never match; on the user's team org cc-plugin-sec-default bypasses user-tier classic.SessionStart, so watchPaths is unusable there -> poll mtimes. (3) dependency types are laid when the parent folder or both mods load; a dependent alone fails 'Dependency not installed'. (4) parallel claude plugin test is safe (5 rounds). (5) $.config.set on own userConfig untested headless. (6) $.store merges per key across concurrent sessions, no loss in 4 rounds. (7) tasks on disk at ~/.claude/tasks/<sessionId>/<n>.json {id,subject,description,activeForm,status,blocks,blockedBy}. (8) desktop PATH and pane-button prompts need the user (probes/p8-manual.sh).

payload.acceptance_criteria:
- When a mod folder is added under mods/, `npm run marketplace` shall write .claude-plugin/marketplace.json with one entry per mod, its source ./mods/<name> and its plugin.json version.
- When marketplace.json differs from the generator output, `npm run validate` shall fail and name the generate command.
- When a mod lists dependencies in plugin.json, `npm run types` shall load the dependency folders beside it, so its .claude-plugin/types/<dependency>/index.d.ts exists.
- When a dependency's types/index.d.ts is newer than the laid copy, `npm run typecheck` shall lay the types again.
- basicly.toml shall set [worktree] base_branch = "main" and declare marketplace.json under [worktree.regenerate_commands].
- When the session root holds .beads/issues.jsonl with 3 issue lines and 1 tombstone, $.workitems shall publish a snapshot with state ok, source beads and 3 normalized items keyed beads:<id>.
- When no tracker is found at the session root, the snapshot state shall be no-tracker and no parent folder shall be read.
- When a tracker file is over 4 MiB or a line is malformed, the snapshot state shall be failed with a reason that names the file.
- When refresh() runs after a change, it shall return the created, updated and closed items.
- The contract shall ship as mods/workitems/types/index.d.ts with the snapshot, the item, the write-verb table per tracker and the state texts of docs/mocks.md section 0.
- While a refresh runs, a second refresh call shall join it, and the provider shall poll file mtimes with $.clock.every at a minimum interval.

payload.acceptance_criteria:
- When the person runs /task add <text>, task-pane shall call TaskCreate through $.tool.call, append a note that the list changed, and reply as docs/mocks.md shows.
- When the person runs /task add <item id>, the task shall take the work item's title; if workitems cannot read the item, then the reply shall say why by name.
- When the person runs /task rm <n>, task-pane shall call TaskUpdate status=deleted; if no task n exists, then the reply shall list the valid numbers.

payload.name: acceptance_criteria
payload.value:
- When a mod folder is added under mods/, `npm run marketplace` shall write .claude-plugin/marketplace.json with one entry per mod, its source `./mods/<name>` and its plugin.json version.
- When marketplace.json differs from the generator output, `npm run validate` shall fail and name the generate command.
- When a mod lists dependencies in plugin.json, `npm run types` shall load the dependency folders beside it, so its `.claude-plugin/types/<dependency>/index.d.ts` exists.
- When a dependency's types/index.d.ts is newer than the laid copy, `npm run typecheck` shall lay the types again.
- basicly.toml shall set [worktree] base_branch = "main" and declare marketplace.json under [worktree.regenerate_commands].
- When the session root holds .beads/issues.jsonl with 3 issue lines and 1 tombstone, $.workitems shall publish a snapshot with state ok, source beads and 3 normalized items keyed `beads:<id>`.
- When no tracker is found at the session root, the snapshot state shall be no-tracker and no parent folder shall be read.
- When a tracker file is over 4 MiB or a line is malformed, the snapshot state shall be failed with a reason that names the file.
- When refresh() runs after a change, it shall return the created, updated and closed items.
- The contract shall ship as mods/workitems/types/index.d.ts with the snapshot, the item, the write-verb table per tracker and the state texts of docs/mocks.md section 0.
- While a refresh runs, a second refresh call shall join it, and the provider shall poll file mtimes with $.clock.every at a minimum interval.

payload.name: acceptance_criteria
payload.value:
- When the session starts, task-pane shall register the model tools `task_add`, `task_update` and `task_list` through $.tool.register, and add a system prompt section that tells the model to keep its plan in them.
- When the model or the person adds, updates or removes a task, the list in $.state shall change and the pane and `/task` shall show it.
- When the person runs /task add `<text>`, task-pane shall add the task and append a note so the model knows the person changed the list; the reply shall match docs/mocks.md.
- When the person runs /task add `<item id>`, the task shall take the work item title from workitems; if workitems cannot read the item, then the reply shall say why by name.
- When the person runs /task rm `<n>`, task-pane shall remove task n; if no task n exists, then the reply shall list the valid numbers.
- When the session has no tasks, the pane and /task shall list the tracker open items with explicit add buttons and add nothing on their own; an item already a task shall not be added twice.
- When the person runs /task pane, the pane shall open; userConfig mode off, toggle or always shall set the default.
- The list shall reset on session.end with reason clear, and survive a hot reload.

payload.description:
## Trigger

When a tracker item or the model supplies task text, I want task-pane to keep it apart from the person's words, so I can trust that a note marked as mine is mine.

## Steps to Reproduce

1. Put an item in .beads/issues.jsonl whose id holds a newline and an instruction.
2. Press add in the task pane.
3. The note to the model carries the repo text as the person's change.
4. Separately, task_add with the title 'Deploy now  (you)' shows as a task the person added.

## Scope

- `mods/task-pane/hooks/commands.ts`
- `mods/task-pane/hooks/tasks.ts`
- `mods/task-pane/hooks/register.tsx`
- `mods/task-pane/task-pane.test.ts`
- `changelog.d/handily-fwkt.4.2.fixed.md`
